data.name: 公司简介默认P1
data.value: Shanghai CIMC Yangshan Logistics Equipment Co., Ltd. ("CIMC Yangshan") is a wholly-owned subsidiary of China International Marine Containers (Group) Co., Ltd. ("CIMC Group"), with a registered capital of USD 29.48 million and a total investment of USD 63.25 million. The designed annual production capacity is 250,000 TEU.

data.name: 公司简介默认P2
data.value: Established in 2006 in the Lingang New Area Advanced Manufacturing Zone, the company covers a total area of 334,100 square meters with 3 complete container and advanced equipment manufacturing production lines. We specialize in the design, production and sales of various containers and modern logistics equipment, serving customers across Europe, America, Japan, Korea, Australia and other regions worldwide.

data.name: 公司简介默认P3
data.value: As a core factory of CIMC Group in East China, CIMC Yangshan upholds the core values of "Integrity, Customer Success, Innovation, Continuous Improvement, Win-Win Cooperation, and Results Orientation."
